Medisense Pro for Healthcare Professionals

The next-gen app for all healthcare professionals across the globe. Simply put, the app enables doctors and other healthcare professionals to expand their knowledge and extend their services to users across geographies. 

Medisense Pro is a one stop app that all healthcare professionals can use to build strong online presence, manage individual online practice and accept video consultation requests from users across the globe.

While the medical professionals involve themselves in giving high quality trusted care to patients, Medisense will focus on assisting healthcare with the latest technology to provide world class care.

Here’s what healthcare professionals can do with Medisense Pro app: 
1. Maintain a global profile: Boost your profile in the global healthcare network with our best tech assistance. Share your professional interest areas and philosophy on patient care for the benefit of everyone.
2. Consult globally: Medisense Pro allows you to take video consultation requests from users across the globe.
3. Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to medical content and consume information on latest innovations in healthcare with  Blogs /Vlogs.
4. Manage your practice: Set your online consultation schedules and consult at your convenience. You may show yourself as “available online” and opt to go online at your convenience. 
5. Video Consultations: Participate in pre-booked and instant online consultations through the app. Receive video consultation requests without your mobile number being shared with anyone.
6. Health Passport: Understand important health conditions of patients when they share their health passport prior to a consultation. You will have some time to go through their basic information even before the patient connects to the call, while the user is making the online payment for the consultation. 
7. Two-way feedback: We believe that good work needs to be appreciated and recognized while the improvement areas need to be addressed, hence, our on-approval feedback mechanism helps you gain control of your reviews. To protect all healthcare professionals registered with us we allow you to give feedback on the users after every consult. This will not be displayed to the users.
8. Using top-end technologies and easy to use user interface, we ensure quality and integrity are top priorities for services rendered on our app.  All data is stored securely on cloud storage. 

Why are camera & microphone access requested?
Users are requested camera and microphone access to enable video or audio consultations. This access also enables users to store and share health related documents in the app. Please visit privacy policy for more information.

Why is SMS access needed? 
Users are requested SMS access to enable phone based One Time password (OTP) authentication, auto verify OTP and registration into the app. Please visit privacy policy for more information.

Why is location access needed?
Users are requested for location access to enable search feature in the app and find nearby service providers. This information is also used to help complete the registration form. viz.  registration address. Please visit privacy policy for more information.

Why is photos access needed?
Users are requested photos and/or gallery access to enable storage and retrieval of files related. Please visit privacy policy for more information.
